Reference drops photons (pid 6) with pT<0.8 and E<1.8 GeV; I test the rectangle corners, neutral hadrons, charged particles and P jets.
Original logits on the same constructed jets and on P jets with in-rectangle photons removed, to compare with the reference.
Residual statistics with a dropped soft photon; looking for saturated channels usable as a constant query component.
Same jets without the photon; difference shows how the photon effect propagates through layers.
Block-0 MLP pre-activations for tokens around the soft-neutral rectangle; used to reconstruct the block-0 MLP input and design a gate unit.
E1 creates a gate vector (norm ~10) only on neutral tokens with pT<0.8 and E<1.8 after block 0, cancelling the helper channels; non-gated tokens should be nearly unchanged.
E1b (sharper steps, zeroed helper columns) gates only target tokens; capture residuals at block inputs to estimate null directions and gate signal for per-block key suppression.
E1b (sharper steps, zeroed helper columns) gates only target tokens; capture residuals at block inputs to estimate null directions and gate signal for per-block key suppression.
E1b (sharper steps, zeroed helper columns) gates only target tokens; capture residuals at block inputs to estimate null directions and gate signal for per-block key suppression.

Gate on neutral tokens with pT<0.8,E<1.8 plus rank-1 key suppression/value zeroing in body blocks 1-11 and classifier blocks removes those tokens from attention; residual error from kNN path and normal-token leakage in late blocks.
Gate-only edit with G=100; 256 clean jets give a large normal-token sample for whitening the gate readout, 96 mixed jets give gated-token states.
Gate-only edit with G=100; 256 clean jets give a large normal-token sample for whitening the gate readout, 96 mixed jets give gated-token states.
Gate-only edit with G=100; 256 clean jets give a large normal-token sample for whitening the gate readout, 96 mixed jets give gated-token states.

Gate-only: gated neutral soft tokens are saturated to a fixed sign pattern anti-aligned with query directions, so they get naturally ~e^-7 attention; no per-block edits. Tests natural suppression incl. unknown interaction bias.
Gate plus rank-1 key suppression/value zeroing sized from measured need (T~5) with whitened readout of the fixed saturated pattern; lower leak than D2.
Same gate as E1d but additionally requires E>=pT and |deta|,|dphi|<1 (true for real constituents), which noised generator tokens often violate; expect same E_ref and clean metrics, lower gen_drift.

Time-aware gate: block-0 attention (previously dead) broadcasts presence of the time token (t>0) so the soft-neutral gate fires only at t=0; classification identical to E1d, generator essentially unchanged.

Adds the neutral-hadron rule (pid 7 with E<2.2 GeV dropped, found from P jets) as a second gate and saturates the block-0 time marker exactly (norm1 alpha=1); expect clean error back to ~0 and lower P error.
E4 plus rank-1 key suppression/value zeroing only in body blocks 1-4 where the gate readout leak is <2e-3; should cut residual leakage of the saturated token in early blocks at negligible clean cost.
E4 plus rank-1 key/value edits in all body blocks and both classifier blocks; measures how much residual error is removable by explicit suppression versus the leak cost (clean error).
E4 plus value-zeroing only (no key change) in all blocks; tests whether the residual comes from the garbage value of the weakly attended saturated token.
Explicit rank-1 suppression only in body block 1 (lowest leak, worst natural margin).
Explicit suppression in blocks 1 and 3 (the two blocks with the worst natural margins).
Explicit suppression in blocks 1-5; block 5 leak p99 4e-3 so small clean cost, maybe slightly better than 1-4.
E4 with the photon and neutral-hadron ANDs merged into one weighted threshold unit (exhaustively checked); identical behaviour, 512 fewer DoF.
Explicit rank-1 suppression only in body block 3, which carried most of the gain in the {1,3} test.
Explicit suppression in blocks 2-4 (block 1 gave no gain alone).
Explicit suppression in blocks 3 and 4.
